Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

mmsyFM 0.1.0

  • Adriatic demersal draft (adriatic_system_draft(), preset in the app): GFCM GSAs 17-18, ten stocks incl. four Norway lobster functional units, five fleets on five areas; built in data-raw/adriatic_build.R.

  • ms_condition(on = "F") conditions on assessed F/Fmsy; species column dep_now and ms_start() start projections from the assessed biomass (option “Start from” in the app).

  • Management plans: species columns plan and unit, segment column plan; hcr_effort(segments =); app rules “HCR plan stocks” and “HCR plan stocks, pooled units” (default when a system defines a plan).

  • ms_landscape(distribution =): stock distribution by cell, e.g. from species distribution models.

  • Assessment strategies in the app: rules with indicator species, species complexes (pooled biomass or CPUE) and nominal assignment of stocks to fleets, compared with the all-stocks rule; defaults from ms_assessment_presets().

  • First version, ported from the dev-mmsy prototype in cpueTargeting and combined with the multispecies MSY app (mmsyapp).

  • Systems: ms_system() from four tables; habitat landscape for catchability (ms_landscape()); Atlantic example and Gulf of Thailand draft (atlantic_system(), got_system_draft()).

  • Calibration: ms_tune() (fleet composition at open access) and ms_condition() (stock status, e.g. 2024 depletions).

  • Stocks: discrete Schaefer with exact F/Fmsy (harvest-rate ratio), F cap (persistence floor), JABBA-type process error scaled by r and depletion, and JABBA’s floor in the process equation.

  • Equilibrium analyses: yield curves, shared-q comparison, safeguarded MMSY (ms_optimise(); total yield, revenue, profit or the catch of one stock).

  • Harvest strategies: hcr_effort() with full effort at the MMSY days, value-weighted or weakest-link status, triggers by segment, minimum effort, phased annual changes, stock-triggered closures, indicator species, complexes and nominal assignment; fixed metier closures (ms_closure()); trigger tuning (ms_tune_hcr()).

  • Performance statistics in the mseviz format (ms_perf()), boxplots, trade-offs and colour-coded decision tables (plot_quilt()).

  • Shiny app (run_app()) with a guide and a management-options tab.

Developed by Henning Winker, Ricardo Amoroso, Maite Pons, Rishi Sharma.
